headline: Sources: Giants to release fan favorite Odell Beckham Jr.
summary: The Giants are releasing veteran wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr., sources told NFL Network.

headline: Bengals cut WR Ke'Shawn Williams after costly muffed punt
summary: The Cincinnati Bengals cut WR Ke'Shawn Williams after he muffed a punt that eventually led to the Pittsburgh Steelers' 30-27 win. On Tuesday, Cincinnati signed WR Mitch Tinsley.

headline: Giants Among Suitors For Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr.?
summary: On Sunday, the Lions and Cowboys were identified as teams which have made trade inquiries about Joey Porter Jr. The oft-discussed Steelers cornerback appears to be on the radar of at least one other NFC team. headline: Sources: Panthers OL Damien Lewis (UCL injury) to miss time
summary: Panthers left guard Damien Lewis has a UCL injury in an elbow and will be out a few weeks, sources told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo and Ian Rapoport.

headline: Inside George Kittle's 243-day recovery from torn Achilles
summary: Despite tearing his Achilles in the playoffs, Kittle appears to be back to his normal self. Here's how he won the recovery process.
